## Gap ID
OPS-005

## Source
gap-analysis-operational

## Description
OSimFlow has per-sample retry via `--max-sample-retries` but only for transient errors (exit code set). Non-transient errors like model geometry failures are not retried even if retries are requested.

## Evidence
- `osimflow/work.py` — transient error classification
- Model geometry errors are non-transient
- No mechanism to distinguish retriable vs non-retriable failures

## Severity
Major

## Recommended Mitigation
1. Add error classification for geometry failures
2. Allow configuration of retriable error types
3. Add `--retry-on-geometry-error` flag
4. Document retry behavior clearly

## Labels
gap-analysis, operational, retry, error-handling, major
